title: Section XV Note 1(m) Exclusion of Chapter 96 Articles
text: Section XV Note 1: This Section does not cover: ... (m) Articles of Chapter 96 (for example, pens, lighters, vacuum flasks or other vacuum vessels complete with cases, and parts thereof); or buttons, pens, pencil holders, pen nibs, monopods, bipods, tripods and similar articles of heading 9620.
source_doc: CBIC Customs Tariff Section XV Notes 2023

title: Section XV Note 2 Parts of General Use
text: Throughout the Nomenclature, the expression 'parts of general use' means: (a) Articles of heading 7307, 7312, 7315, 7317 or 7318 and similar articles of other base metal; (b) Springs and leaves for springs, of base metal, other than clock or watch springs (heading 9114); and (c) Articles of headings 8301, 8302, 8308, 8310 and frames and mirrors, of base metal, of heading 8306.
source_doc: CBIC Customs Tariff Section XV Notes 2023

title: Section XX Note 1 Scope of Miscellaneous Manufactured Articles
text: Section XX covers miscellaneous manufactured articles including furniture, toys, games and miscellaneous manufactured articles of Chapter 96 such as pens, buttons, lighters, vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels.
source_doc: CBIC Customs Tariff Section XX Notes 2023
